text: The Patriots improved to 2-0 in the AFC East with their third straight victory, a 26-19 win over the Jets that saw Drake Maye throw three touchdown passes to stave off a late New York push, though the day wasn't without its complications on the receiving end—A.J. Brown, returning from a four-week absence due to a right high ankle sprain, struggled with his timing and dropped a career-high three passes, while Romeo Doubs suffered an injury after hauling in a spectacular 42-yard touchdown reception with 4:10 left in the first quarter. Mike Vrabel's locker room philosophy of never apologizing for wins appears to be holding firm as New England extends its grip atop the division, though the coaching staff will undoubtedly want to assess both Brown's reintegration into the offense and the extent of Doubs' injury moving forward.
